title: MotorBase Engine Specification Template
description: Standardized JSON document describing every measurement specification needed to build/inspect an engine type (e.g. VG33E). A user downloads a blank template, fills in the values, and uploads it; MotorBase stores it as an engine-type specification set and uses it to validate the measurement workflow.

specVersion.description: Version of THIS template format (not the user's data revision).

source.description: Where the values came from (user reference); do not paste copyrighted manual text.

revision.description: User's revision/version label for this data set.

component.description: Maps to a task-template category (cylinders, pistons, cylinder_head, valvetrain, crankshaft, connecting_rod, rings, block, bearings).

key.description: Stable measurement key unique within the section, e.g. stem_diameter.

unit.description: e.g. mm, cc, deg, N, kPa.

appliesTo.description: Optional qualifier such as intake, exhaust, outer, inner.

perLocation.description: True when the reading is repeated at multiple locations (per cylinder/journal/valve).

locations.description: Location labels when perLocation is true, e.g. [cyl1, cyl2, ...].

nominal.description: Single target value when there is no min/max range (e.g. valve clearance 0).

standard.description: Acceptable standard/new range. Use max only for 'less than X' style specs.

limit.description: Service/wear limit. limit.max for an upper wear limit; limit.min for a 'more than X' minimum.

grades.description: Per-grade sub-ranges for graded/selective-fit parts (piston/bearing grades, oversizes).

atValue.description: Reference condition for the value, e.g. spring pressure measured at this installed height.

derived.description: True when the value is computed from other measurements (e.g. a volume or the compression ratio) rather than measured directly.

formula.description: Human-readable formula for a derived measurement, referencing other measurement keys, e.g. (swept_volume + clearance_volume) / clearance_volume.
